title: Introducing Spyglass: Your New Insights Companion
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, a powerful new tool designed to provide you with enhanced insights and capabilities.

title: Master Your Files with Enhanced Editor Control
summary: Effortlessly manage your images and files directly within the editor, giving you more control over their appearance and interaction to enhance your content creation.

title: Introducing Our New Product Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap page provides a transparent overview of recent achievements, upcoming features, and exciting future plans, keeping you informed every step of the way.

title: Improved Checkbox Experience
summary: Our updated checkboxes are now effortlessly clickable, draggable, and beautifully designed to bring a more seamless and intuitive experience to your workflow.

title: Seamless Teamwork in the Editor
summary: We've significantly enhanced the collaboration experience in the editor, making it easier and more intuitive to work with your team.

title: Effortless Discovery of Shared Content
summary: Seamlessly find all relevant items shared with you directly within your search results, making collaboration and discovery more efficient and enjoyable.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source
summary: Noeko is now fully open source, empowering our community with complete transparency and the ability to directly shape its future.

title: Go Global with Multilingual Support
summary: Soon, Noeko will speak your language, enabling a truly global experience for everyone.

title: Elevate Your Workspace: Enhanced Themes & Fresh Styles
summary: Prepare for a stunning visual upgrade as we refine existing themes and introduce a diverse collection of beautiful new styles, allowing you to personalize your Noeko experience like never before.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Constellation
summary: Unlock the full potential of your knowledge base with an enhanced Constellation view featuring advanced filtering by tags and time, alongside effortless sharing.

title: Master Your Knowledge with Advanced Search and Saved Compendiums
summary: Gain unparalleled control over your information by leveraging new filtering and sorting options, enabling you to create and save dynamic Compendiums of precisely what you need, exactly when you need it.

title: Dynamic Note Previews
summary: Enjoy a more intuitive and interactive way to organize your thoughts with flexible content previews that seamlessly integrate linked notes into your workflow.

title: Noeko's Grand Debut: Flexible Hosting and Premium Features
summary: Get ready for Noeko's full release, featuring versatile self-hosting options alongside premium plans that unlock advanced capabilities through a seamless payment and permission system.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: We're enhancing your experience by ensuring all in-app greetings accurately reflect the precise time of day, creating a more personalized and intuitive feel.

title: Quick Actions for Tagged Content
summary: Unlock greater control over your categorized content with streamlined actions, empowering you to effortlessly remove items from tags, delete content, or access details directly from any tag overview.

title: Diverse Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate a broader range of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text documents, to power your insights and learning.
